corrections.why: All three sources describe a 20-foot tower (about 6.1 m). The 9.1 m (30 ft) figure appears only in the August 1932 approval note, which describes a tower planned before construction.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and Forest Lookouts give 1933 (Forest Lookouts shows approval in 1932 and completion in 1933); firelookout.com gives 1932. The record keeps 1933 as the structured year and the story reports both.
The register says removed by 1969; firelookout.com says destroyed by 1969. Both are kept in the event note and the story reports both.
A 1932 approval note mentions a 30-foot tower, but the completed tower is 20 feet in all three sources. The record uses 6.1 m.

notes_for_editor: No source describes the site today. Access is omitted because no source describes it. A search snippet from AllTrails (the page returned HTTP 403 and was not read) describes a lookout at the summit; if that is accurate the gone status is wrong, so check before publishing. The State Library of Oregon record for the 1991 Forest Service eligibility study of Deschutes lookouts was read only as metadata; the study itself may cover this site. No photos added because no image URLs were captured.
